title: Subtitles for long recordings
description: Processing carries on stage by stage, and the result can be checked and exported in full.

blocks.text: A limit on length gets in the way of starting work on a lecture or an interview. A review confirms the need for a longer recording, but it does not yet show which checking tools its author needs. Splitting into stretches and recovering after a failure is one possible way to make this work manageable.

quote.text: Make it so we could have no cap on how long the video can be that would be nice but most videos on YouTube are about 10-15 min.

blocks.text: Keep the stretches that have been processed, show the gaps and allow carrying on from the right spot. Offer a separate export of the text with time markers.
The limit on duration and the terms of processing have to be shown before the upload. Check the finished file across its whole running time, including the end.
